bluf: Webrepublic is an independent Zurich agency selling itself as a national alternative to the multinational networks, with paid search, paid social and programmatic at its core. The record points it toward AI in search: a Migros Bank case dated 2026-09-28 credits SEO and GEO with +519% organic visibility, and a ChatGPT Ads Switzerland briefing leads its news. Its book holds 7 clients, 5 observed and 2 names only. A rival should know it runs its own LinkedIn ads, 13 on record, while the Horus read marks its core paid lines most exposed to the platforms absorbing execution.
doing:
Webrepublic sells integrated media to enterprises. Its positioning line, a Zurich integrated marketing agency and an independent national alternative to multinational networks, combining strategy, media, technology and creative across online and offline touchpoints, means: an independent media shop that plans and buys across channels, sold against the holding company networks. The headline claim is three homepage success stories: an always on strategy for SWICA, a video strategy for AMAG and a safer cycling activation for Pro Velo Schweiz.

The sold mix has no lead line. Paid Search, Paid Social and Programmatic & CTV score 2 and form the core: an SEA agency page, Performance & Automation as one of five pillars and a ChatGPT Ads briefing leading the homepage news; a social media agency page and a news item titled TikTok Partner Badge, the one partner the record infers; programmatic and 360° media pages, the YouTube Impact Engine planning approach, its one proprietary item, and LinkedIn webinars on ad recall and impact. SEO, AI Search / GEO, Content & Digital PR, Creator & Influencer and Data & Measurement score 1 without notes, although the newest case, Migros Bank, is an SEO and GEO case.

Its AI posture runs through search: a GEO technical SEO checklist for LLM visibility, the ChatGPT Ads Switzerland briefing and a pitch of pioneering technologies and automation; AI Automation itself scores 0. The record lists no dated moves or news. The case library, 21 case studies in English and German, runs from Firstcaution (2024-10-10) and Migros talent marketing (2024-11-12) through AMAG (2025-09-02), Pro Velo (2026-04-27) and SWICA (2026-04-28) to Migros Bank (2026-09-28). The record lists no pricing signal, headcount, founding year or open roles. Conspicuously absent for an enterprise media agency: any first party data, CRM or retail media line.
clients:
The client type is enterprise and the record lists no verticals; the home market is Zurich, its one office. The needs read holds 7 clients, 5 observed and 2 names only, all from case studies; brand and creative leads the mix (3 clients), then organic demand, web build and AI and automation (2 each).

SWICA came for brand and creative: strategic media planning that, per the excerpt, raised brand relevance and grew its supplementary insurance business (2026-04-28). AMAG came for brand and measurement: a video strategy claiming strong recall at lower cost, with recall tracking (2025-09-02). Firstcaution came for an omnichannel awareness campaign (2024-10-10). Migros Bank came for organic demand, web build and AI: content consolidation and a domain migration that, per the case, drove +519% organic visibility and +95% clicks through SEO and GEO (2026-09-28).

Two codings are judgment calls. Migros carries the Migros Bank signal, very likely a name match; its own case is data driven talent marketing that raised recruitment efficiency, run with Liip (2024-11-12), a data and recruiting need rather than organic search. The 2 names only are both Pro Velo, listed as Pro Velo and as Pro Velo Schweiz, and its case describes a multichannel activation that hit its sign up goal early (2026-04-27). The apprenticeship campaign for login Berufsbildung AG appears in case studies but not in the needs read. No client is shared with another tracked agency.

Under KJ4 (the platforms absorbing the execution layer) it is likely, moderate confidence, that SWICA, AMAG and Firstcaution will want impact proof like the AMAG recall result rather than buying and trafficking; under KJ1 the SEO and GEO work for Migros Bank likely extends to citation tracking (low confidence).
house: Say and do: two lines tested, one practised. LinkedIn advertising is corroborated: the LinkedIn check shows 13 ads of its own, 10 company page ads and 3 thought leader ads by staff, promoting its Lost in Clicks and Impact Unpacked webinars; one reads "Millionen Impressionen, aber kaum jemand erinnert sich an eure Werbung?" Paid social is contradicted: it sells social media advertising and the check finds no social ad pixel on its site, but the tag check detected only GTM, so that read is thin (low confidence). Paid search is unknown: the Transparency Center lookup was blocked. The sitemap lists 125 URLs, 9 updated in 90 days and 16 in 365, with 4 AI topic URLs; the newest insights, dated 2026-09-04 to 2026-09-28, cover ChatGPT Ads and YouTube inventory in English and German. It publishes no llms.txt, blocks no AI crawlers and runs on WordPress.
market:
The Horus read puts Webrepublic at a tailwind index of 0.3, band Neutral, percentile 21. It is best placed for KJ1 (the click replaced by the citation) and KJ2 (ads inside AI answers), both driven by AI Search / GEO and Paid Search. It is most exposed to KJ4 (the platforms absorbing the execution layer), driven by Paid Search and Paid Social with Data & Measurement as the offset, and to KJ6 (the agency middle hollowed out), driven by Paid Search, Paid Social and SEO. Best scenario fit: The Walled Oasis at 32/100. It is partial on P1, P4 and P8, absent on P2, P6 and P7, unknown on P5; P3 does not apply.

The Monsoon read is 40.8, band Breeze, percentile 10: migration 43.3 against displacement 38.3. The sold mix supplies 43 of the index, Paid Search (11) and SEO (8) carrying the most movable hours, and automation overlaps 41% of them; the work would go 55% to Eastern Europe and 35% to South and Southeast Asia. The footprint is inferred, with no hub office and no onshore claim.
openings:
The strongest opening is KJ4 on its core. Paid search, paid social and programmatic are the lines the Horus read says the platforms are absorbing, and the record shows no first party data or creative volume behind them (P4 partial), the AMAG recall case being the one measurement exception. It is likely, moderate confidence, that a rival selling the inputs automation runs on, first party data and creative volume with holdout tested measurement, wins enterprise media reviews against it. Falsifier: a later compile showing first party data or incrementality work at Webrepublic.

The paid social contradiction is a secondary lead, low confidence given the thin tag read. On ads inside assistants it talks but shows no holdout capability (P8 partial), so the first rival to publish a controlled ChatGPT Ads test in its market sets the price, and there is no public pricing to compare against (P5 unknown). The oldest cases, Firstcaution (2024-10-10) and Migros talent marketing (2024-11-12), are the accounts most worth testing, roughly even chance they are still active; SWICA, AMAG and Pro Velo Schweiz, the homepage stories, are unlikely to move. Displacement at 38.3 says the book does not buy on price.
watch: I7, holiday 2026 agentic checkout volume and merchant opt out rates, December 2026 to January 2027: high opt out rates would slow KJ4, the judgment its core paid lines are most exposed to.
I2, Alphabet Q3 2026 search growth and AI Mode ad disclosures, late October 2026: growth above 15% with AI Mode ads live would confirm S1 and strengthen the KJ1 tailwind its GEO work rides.
I10, Reddit US daily users against search referral volatility, late October 2026: US DAUq growth at or below 5% alongside AI Mode growth would confirm the UGC starvation risk under KJ1.

I8, holdco Q3 organic growth, headcount and pricing model disclosures, October 2026: outcome pricing at a top five holdco would test an independent that sells against the networks with no public pricing.
The ChatGPT Ads briefing, updated 2026-09-28: a follow up showing a holdout tested assistant ad campaign would move P8 from partial and close the assistant ads opening.
